针对 Flux.1 开发 (GGUF) 优化的低 VRAM 多 LoRA 工作流程

Experimental_dAIver 的另一个新的、改进的和增强的工作流程

该工作流程充分发挥了Flux.1 开发GGUF 格式，专门针对 VRAM 小于 8 GB 的 GPU 进行了优化，例如我的 RTX 4050 只有 6 GB。集成的CacheDiT_Model_Optimizer和PatchSageAttentionKJ（两者都是可选的！）提供显着的速度提升，几乎没有质量损失。满NdSuperLora装载机支持轻松的多 LoRA 堆叠，具有自动触发字集成、直观的selectLatentSizePlus宽高比和分辨率选择器，以及完整的SEEDVR2 视频升级器子图（由 @LumaRift 提供的基础）令人惊叹的高分辨率结果完成了这个优雅且高度灵活的设置。

1.5版是我的第一个公开版本，在速度、可用性、多 LoRA 处理和升级质量方面带来了显着改进，同时保持极高的 VRAM 效率（在仅 6 GB 的 RTX 4050 上测试）。

v1.5 的主要功能：

  • NdSuperLora装载机具有完整的多 LoRA 支持、自动获取触发字和轻松的强度控制

  • selectLatentSizePlus- 直观的宽高比和分辨率选择器，具有漂亮的预设（包括黄金比例友好选项）以及简单的方向交换

  • 完整 SEEDVR2 视频升级器子图— 强大的基于 DiT 的高端升级器，通过智能分辨率处理、Lab 色彩校正和时间设置提供令人惊叹的 4K+ 结果。在静态图像上也表现出色，可产生卓越的细节和连贯性

  • 改进的工作流程组织、使用推荐设置扩展注释以及通过 SaveImageExtended 提供更强大的保存选项

  • CacheDiT 和 SageAttention 集成可在低 VRAM 硬件上优化 Flux 性能

所需的自定义节点

  • ComfyUI-GGUF -https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF- UnetLoaderGGUF + CLIPLoaderGGUF

  • nd-超级节点-https://github.com/HenkDz/nd-super-nodes- NdSuperLoraLoader 带有标签、触发词和漂亮的 UI

  • 保存图像扩展-comfyui -https://github.com/thedyze/save-image-extended-comfyui- 使用元数据和动态文件名进行高级保存

  • 舒适型 - https://github.com/MzMaXaM/ComfyUi-MzMaXaM- 选择LatentSizePlus

  • ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler - https://github.com/numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler- SEEDVR2 视频升级器子图

模型和下载（确切路径）

以下列表解释了我在此工作流程中最常使用的基本模型。该列表还解释了下载每个文件后将其放置在哪里。

1.主模型（Flux.1 Dev GGUF）：

  • 文件：Flux1-dev-Q5_1.gguf（或您喜欢的任何其他 GGUF 定量 - Q4、Q5、Q6 或 Q8 都运行良好）

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/city96/FLUX.1-dev-gguf/resolve/main/flux1-dev-Q5_1.gguf

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/ （或 Flux/ 子文件夹）

2. 文本编码器（CLIP）

  • 文件：t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors + Clip_l.safetensors（标准通量对）

  • 下载t5xxl：https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors
    下载clip_l：https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/clip_l.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/models/clip/ 或 ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

3.VAE

  • 文件：安全张量

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux1-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/vae/

4.升级者

  • 4× 升级器：4x-UltraSharp →https://civitai.com/models/116225/4x-ultrasharp

  • 1× 皮肤对比度放大器：1xSkinContrast-High-SuperUltraCompact.pth →https://huggingface.co/notkenski/upscalers/blob/main/1xSkinContrast-High-SuperUltraCompact.pth

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/upscale_models/

5. LoRA（用于 NdSuperLoraLoader – 完整的多 LoRA 支持）

  • 任何与 Flux 兼容的 LoRA (.safetensors)

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/loras/

6. SEEDVR2 模型（用于高端升级子图 - 可选但推荐）

  • 迪特型号：Seedvr2_ema_3b-Q8_0.gguf

  • VAE：ema_vae_fp16.safetensors

  • 从官方 ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler 存储库或 Hugging Face 下载并放入自定义节点所需的文件夹中。

推荐设置

采样器：欧拉或欧拉祖先

调度程序：简单、普通或测试版

步骤：20–40CFG 规模：1.0

通量指南：3-6

班次：4-7

分辨率：可通过 selectLatentSizePlus 节点自由选择（包括许多黄金比例友好的预设，一键交换方向）

如何使用工作流程

  1. 在 ComfyUI 中加载 JSON。

  2. 在“宽高比”和“分辨率”中选择您想要的宽高比和分辨率selectLatentSizePlus节点（如果需要，启用 swap_orientation）。

  3. 在 Positive Prompt 节点中输入您的提示（NdSuperLoraLoader 会自动从您的 LoRA 中提取触发词）。

  4. （可选）将一个或多个与 Flux 兼容的 LoRA 加载到 NdSuperLoraLoader 中 - 强度和触发器得到优雅的处理。

  5. 产生。第一阶段产生高质量的基础图像。

  6. （可选）运行 SEEDVR2 放大子图以获得漂亮的 2-4 倍放大甚至视频。它在静止图像上也很有效。

  7. SaveImageExtended 节点使您可以完全控制文件名、元数据和文件夹结构。

如果您只想快速生成测试，则可以绕过整个升级器组。该工作流程还适用于常规 .safetensors Flux 检查点 - 只需将 UnetLoaderGGUF 和 DualCLIPLoader 替换为标准节点即可。

这是一个干净、强大且面向未来的基础，适合您所有 Flux.1 开发工作 - 无论您想要快速的单 LoRA 肖像、复杂的多 LoRA 场景还是高端升级输出。我每天都在我的 6 GB 卡上使用它，感觉快捷可靠。

非常感谢维基百科人工智能感谢原始 WikkedZITv4 基金会以及 CacheDiT、SageAttention、NdSuperLoraLoader、selectLatentSizePlus 和 SeedVR2 的创建者，让低 VRAM Flux 变得如此有趣。

如果您有疑问、反馈或想分享您的结果 – 我总是很高兴在评论中收到您的来信。享受工作流程并快乐创作！

Optimized Low-VRAM Multi-LoRA Workflow for Flux.1 Dev (GGUF)

Another new, refined and enhanced workflow by Experimental_dAIver

This workflow delivers the full power ofFlux.1 Devin GGUF format, specially optimized for GPUs with less than 8 GB VRAM, like my RTX 4050 with only 6 GB. The integratedCacheDiT_Model_OptimizerandPatchSageAttentionKJ(both optional!) provide a noticeable speed boost with almost no quality loss. FullNdSuperLoraLoadersupport for easy multi-LoRA stacking with automatic trigger-word integration, the intuitiveselectLatentSizePlusaspect-ratio and resolution selector, plus a completeSEEDVR2 Video Upscaler Subgraph(base provided by @LumaRift) for stunning high-resolution results complete this elegant and highly flexible setup.

Version 1.5is my first public release and brings significant improvements in speed, usability, multi-LoRA handling and upscaling quality — while remaining extremely VRAM-efficient (tested on RTX 4050 with only 6 GB).

Key features in v1.5:

  • NdSuperLoraLoaderwith full multi-LoRA support, auto-fetch trigger words and easy strength control

  • selectLatentSizePlus— intuitive aspect-ratio and resolution selector with beautiful presets (including golden-ratio-friendly options) plus easy orientation swap

  • Full SEEDVR2 Video Upscaler Subgraph— powerful DiT-based high-end upscaler that delivers stunning 4K+ results with intelligent resolution handling, Lab color correction and temporal settings. Works exceptionally well on still images too, producing superior detail and coherence

  • Improved workflow organization, expanded notes with recommended settings, and more robust saving options via SaveImageExtended

  • CacheDiT and SageAttention integration for optimized Flux performance on low-VRAM hardware

Required Custom Nodes

  • ComfyUI-GGUF -https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF- UnetLoaderGGUF + CLIPLoaderGGUF

  • nd-super-nodes -https://github.com/HenkDz/nd-super-nodes- NdSuperLoraLoader with tags, trigger words & beautiful UI

  • save-image-extended-comfyui -https://github.com/thedyze/save-image-extended-comfyui- Advanced saving with metadata & dynamic filenames

  • ComfyUi-MzMaXaM - https://github.com/MzMaXaM/ComfyUi-MzMaXaM- selectLatentSizePlus

  • ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler - https://github.com/numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler- SEEDVR2 Video Upscaler Subgraph

Models & Downloads (exact paths)

The following list explains the base models I am most frequently using with this workflow. The list as well explains where to put each file after you downloaded it.

1. Main Model (Flux.1 Dev GGUF):

  • File:flux1-dev-Q5_1.gguf (or any other GGUF quant you prefer – Q4, Q5, Q6 or Q8 all work well)

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/city96/FLUX.1-dev-gguf/resolve/main/flux1-dev-Q5_1.gguf

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/ (or Flux/ subfolder)

2. Text Encoder (CLIP)

  • File: t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors + clip_l.safetensors (standard Flux pair)

  • Download t5xxl:https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors
    Download clip_l:https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/clip_l.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/clip/ or ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

3. VAE

  • File:ae.safetensors

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux1-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/vae/

4. Upscalers

  • 4× Upscaler:4x-UltraSharp →https://civitai.com/models/116225/4x-ultrasharp

  • 1× Skin-Contrast Upscaler:1xSkinContrast-High-SuperUltraCompact.pth →https://huggingface.co/notkenski/upscalers/blob/main/1xSkinContrast-High-SuperUltraCompact.pth

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/

5. LoRAs (for NdSuperLoraLoader – full multi-LoRA support)

  • Any Flux-compatible LoRA (.safetensors)

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/loras/

6. SEEDVR2 Models (for the high-end upscaler subgraph – optional but recommended)

  • DiT Model:seedvr2_ema_3b-Q8_0.gguf

  • VAE:ema_vae_fp16.safetensors

  • Download from the official ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler repository or Hugging Face and place in the folders required by the custom node.

Recommended Settings

Sampler:Euler or Euler ancestral

Scheduler:Simple, Normal or Beta

Steps:20–40CFG Scale:1.0

Flux Guidance:3–6

Shift:4–7

Resolution:freely selectable via the selectLatentSizePlus node (many golden-ratio-friendly presets included, swap orientation with one click)

How to use the workflow

  1. Load the JSON in ComfyUI.

  2. Select your desired aspect ratio and resolution in theselectLatentSizePlusnode (enable swap_orientation if needed).

  3. Enter your prompt in the Positive Prompt node (the NdSuperLoraLoader will automatically pull trigger words from your LoRAs).

  4. (Optional) Load one or more Flux-compatible LoRAs into the NdSuperLoraLoader – strengths and triggers are handled elegantly.

  5. Generate. The first stage produces a high-quality base image.

  6. (Optional) Run the SEEDVR2 upscaler subgraph for beautiful 2–4× upscales or even video. It works great on still images too.

  7. The SaveImageExtended node gives you full control over filenames, metadata and folder structure.

You can bypass the entire upscaler group if you just want fast test generations. The workflow also works with regular .safetensors Flux checkpoints – simply replace the UnetLoaderGGUF and DualCLIPLoader with the standard nodes.

This is a clean, powerful and future-proof base for all your Flux.1 Dev work – whether you want fast single-LoRA portraits, complex multi-LoRA scenes or high-end upscaled output. I’ve been using it daily on my 6 GB card and it feels snappy and reliable.

Huge thanks toWikkedAIfor the original WikkedZITv4 foundation and to the creators of CacheDiT, SageAttention, NdSuperLoraLoader, selectLatentSizePlus and SeedVR2 for making low-VRAM Flux so enjoyable.

If you have questions, feedback or want to share your results – I’m always happy to hear from you in the comments. Enjoy the workflow and happy creating!
